newsitem.title: USA: Stanley Works to reorganize into eight units.
newsitem.headline: Stanley Works to reorganize into eight units.

text.p: Stanley Works said Wednesday it plans to reorganize its operations into eight new product groups.
The groups will focus on customers and growth of their businesses by developing new products and expanding market scope, the company said.
It decined to comment on the names or scope of the new product groups.
The groups will be complemented by centralized manufacturing, engineering, sales and service, the company said.
Stanley is also establishing a new corporate marketing and brand development function, whose focus will be the nurturing and leveraging of the Stanley brand.
The company today reported first quarter operating income for the first quarter of $40 million, or $0.45 per share, up from $34 million, or $0.38 per share, a year earlier.
